detail: Full summary: Repo .twining/ contains BOTH legacy file layout (blackboard.jsonl, decisions/, graph/) and v2 artifacts (twining.db, records/) — new endpoints must code against I*Store interfaces (src/storage/interfaces.ts) so the SQLite backend swap keeps working; standalone dashboard constructs file-backed stores.
